More time for care.
More control

p.label: The cost of disconnected software
p.title:
When systems are separate,
your team does the connecting.
p.body: The same patient. Repeated typing. Missing information. Time spent chasing an answer.
p.b1: One record, available to every authorised role
p.b2: Results available in the patient's chart
p.a3: Services checked against the bill by hand
p.b4: One view of activity, workload and revenue
v.label: What changes for your hospital
v.title:
A clearer operation.
A stronger business.
v.b1: Capture services and supplies. Reduce omissions and claims rework.
v.b2: Less retyping and chasing. More capacity in the team you already have.
v.b3: Admissions, beds, workload and revenue in one place.
v.b4: Shared information and built-in checks help staff spot issues sooner.
v.note: We agree the targets together, then measure the change in your hospital.

One continuous process.

t.label: The people behind MediMind
t.title:
Clinical experience.
A team that can deliver.
t.b1: Building around the work he knows from clinical practice.
t.b2: Duke MBA. Nine years at Riot Games, bringing experience in scaling technology.
t.value: For you: a team for implementation, training and development around your needs.
f.label: The direction we are building towards
f.title:
One foundation.
Three stages of progress.
f.b1: Clinical and administrative work on one foundation, adapted to your hospital.
f.b2: Assistants for documentation, clinical checks and administrative tasks. Each service agreed separately.
f.b3: A shared understanding of the hospital that identifies risks and prepares coordinated next steps.
f.note: The base system is the starting point. AI services have separate scope, validation and pricing.
b.label: AI Brain / our long-term vision
b.title:
A hospital that sees
what needs attention.
b.body: A critical result. A delayed task. A missing document. The ambition is to connect the signal with the right person and the next action.
b.safety: AI flags and assists. Your clinicians decide.
b.note: Future capability. Not included in the base offer.
m.label: Your evaluation
m.title:
The evidence comes
from your own numbers.
m.intro: We agree a baseline and success criteria before the evaluation starts.
m.v2: How much capacity the team gains
m.3: Time from discharge to a complete claim
m.v3: How quickly work is ready for reimbursement
m.v4: Where revenue is lost or delayed
m.note: Your current process is the baseline. Your team tests the new one. You decide whether the improvement is enough.
h.label: A controlled transition
h.title:
Your hospital keeps working.
You decide when to switch.
h.b1: Choose the first process, the team and the success criteria.
h.b2: Map data, configure the system and train the team.
h.b3: Compare real work while your current system stays in use.
h.b4: Move forward only when your team accepts the result.
h.note: The evaluation is free, with no obligation to buy. The rollout schedule is agreed around your hospital's readiness.
r.label: Ownership and continuity
r.title:
Your data.
Your first version.
r.b1: An open FHIR R4 format keeps it portable.
r.t2: The first delivered version belongs to you
r.b2: We transfer ownership of the agreed base-system source code under your contract.
r.b3: We document the scope, price, support and ownership rights together.
r.note: Third-party components retain their licences. Rights to later versions and optional AI services are defined separately.
n.label: The next step
n.title:
Let's start with
one process in your hospital.
n.body: We map the process, show the relevant system and agree what a useful evaluation would measure.
n.who: With your director and the person who runs that process. At your hospital or online.
n.action: Send us two times that work for you

it.label: Details / For your IT team
it.title:
Built ground-up
on FHIR R4.
it.body: Clinical data uses an open healthcare standard at its core. Departments work on the same model.
it.b1: A shared foundation for the hospital's clinical and administrative work.
it.b2: FHIR R4 export, with migration and reconciliation agreed before rollout.
it.b3: Roles, permissions and an audit trail of changes.
it.b4: Hospital hosting, cloud or hybrid, with continuity and recovery planned together.
it.note: Your IT team joins the technical review before any transition.
